levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن أبي نصر

notes: Narrated encounter: عبيد بن زرارة reports his own question «ذكرت إسماعيل عند أبي عبد الله» and the Imam's reply «فقال». The Imam is read as the last link (owner ruling 2), but this is a narrated encounter where the Imam speaks, so a ruling is needed (rule 11).
«حدثنا أبي» is bare, so it is a relation link. The blessing «رضي الله عنه» and «عليه السلام» are left out.
